_comment: Lightning 2.0 Phase 4 remediation. An adversarial audit of the merged 20260921064717, run against the live catalogue after it applied, found one blocker and two majors; that file stays as it was applied and this one repairs it. The blocker: fn_cash_cluster_lightning_thresholds guarded its configuration read with jsonb_typeof(...) = 'number' and cast it with ::integer, and those two admit different sets - the guard admits every JSON number, the cast accepts only int4, and everything in the gap raised. {"on_threshold": 18.0} and 18.5 raised 22P02; 2147483648 and 1e300 raised 22003. 18.0 is the shape that matters, because jsonb preserves the trailing zero and to_jsonb(numeric) produces it. The error propagated up through fn_cash_cluster_lightning_state into fn_cash_game_lobby, which is SECURITY DEFINER, granted to authenticated and polled every five seconds while the modal is open, so one badly typed configuration value would have 500'd every lobby open for that Cluster until somebody edited jsonb by hand - while the function's installed COMMENT said the opposite. Armed, not detonated: 0 of 166 Clusters carry ruleset_snapshot -> 'lightning' today. public.fn_cash_cluster_lightning_thresholds_probe(jsonb, integer) is the repair: the whole ON/OFF threshold rule as a pure IMMUTABLE function of a configuration and a handedness, so it can be fuzzed with any shape at all from a @live-proof against production without a Cluster to hang it on. Its guard is one regex over the TEXT form, ^-?[0-9]{1,9}(\.0+)?$, and its cast is floor(...::numeric)::integer, so guard and cast admit the same set: at most nine digits, so int4 cannot overflow, and an optional run of trailing zeros, so 18.0 is accepted AS 18 while 18.5, 1e300 and 2147483648 fall back to the mandated defaults. It is the only place the four mandated numbers are written (6-max ON 18 OFF 12, full ring 27 and 18), and source is per-field now, so a half-applied configuration reports ruleset_partial rather than claiming ruleset. fn_cash_cluster_lightning_thresholds is re-created as a row read and a delegation to it. fn_cash_cluster_lightning_state is re-created for two more reasons: its verdict was blind in the pending states - would_turn_on required cluster_mode must_move and would_turn_off required lightning, so spec Phase 5's own safety re-check at a conversion-safe hand boundary would have aborted every conversion it started - and both filters now widen by exactly one state, to ('must_move', 'pending_on') and ('lightning', 'pending_off'); and it becomes LANGUAGE plpgsql, because both children carry SET search_path and therefore cannot be inlined, so the sql shape planned three levels per call and measured 3.746 ms warm against children costing 0.151 ms together, which was 24% of a 15.6 ms lobby open. All ten top-level keys the lobby embeds are unchanged. No table, no column, no row, no grant to a browser role: three functions, each SECURITY INVOKER with search_path pinned, revoked from PUBLIC, anon and authenticated and granted to service_role only. Nothing here converts anything.
